ignore_patterns: 纯文档/README/错别字/格式微调 (documentation/README/typo/formatting only)
未经立项讨论的大规模代码移植（如 port kiro / rewrite in other lang） (unauthorized large-scale port or language rewrite)
未附带有效日志、配置文件或 curl 复现的纯情绪吐槽/抱怨 (complaints without logs, configs, or curl reproduction)
依赖包自动扫描生成的机械式微小 bump (automated mechanical small dependency bump)
纯前端 UI 样式小修小补 (cosmetic frontend UI/style minor tweaks)

rules.zero_score_instruction: 凡是命中 ignore_patterns 任意一条，必须强制打 0 分 (Level 0)，标记为 invalid / 低优先级 (Score 0 if matching any ignore pattern, mark as invalid/low priority)
